blocks.en: All nine trajectories share one receptor, one force field, one equilibration schedule and one analysis codebase. Four things change between them: which peptide is bound, where it starts and stops, what sits on its C-terminus, and which histidines carry a charge. The map is the shape of those four choices. BoPEP4 sits at the center; each limb is one thing we changed, and each chip on a limb is a trajectory that changed it.

blocks.zh: 九條軌跡共用同一個受體、同一套力場、同一份平衡化流程與同一套分析程式碼。它們之間有四件事不同：結合的是哪一條胜肽、它從哪裡開始到哪裡結束、它的 C 端上接著什麼，以及哪些組胺酸帶電。這張地圖就是那四個選擇的形狀。BoPEP4 位於中心；每一條分支是我們改動的一件事，分支上的每一個小塊則是改動了它的一條軌跡。

blocks.en: Backbone RMSD tracks the salt bridge at Spearman +0.29
blocks.text: Backbone RMSD tracks the salt bridge at Spearman +0.29
blocks.zh: 主鏈 RMSD 與鹽橋的 Spearman 相關只有 +0.29

blocks.en: Eight of the nine runs carry a peptide, which makes this answerable with a number instead of an anecdote. Backbone RMSD over the shared 15-23 window, the kind of score constructs usually get ranked on, correlates with the bidentate Asn23-Arg487 salt bridge at Pearson +0.13 and Spearman +0.29. Against the four-contact clamp it is +0.03 the wrong way. Contact count does better and not by much: +0.26 and +0.55 respectively. Eight trajectories are not eight independent samples, so read these as descriptive, not inferential.

Backbone RMSD over the shared 15-23 window, the kind of score constructs usually get ranked on, correlates with the bidentate Asn23-Arg487 salt bridge at Pearson +0.13 and Spearman +0.29. Against the four-contact clamp it is +0.03 the wrong way. Contact count does better and not by much: +0.26 and +0.55 respectively. Eight trajectories are not eight independent samples, so read these as descriptive, not inferential.
blocks.zh: 九次模擬中有八次帶胜肽，這讓問題可以用數字回答，而不是用個案。共有的 15-23 區段上的主鏈 RMSD，正是構築通常被拿來排名的那種分數，它與雙齒 Asn23-Arg487 鹽橋的相關係數為 Pearson +0.13、Spearman +0.29。對四接觸夾持則是 +0.03，方向還是反的。接觸數好一些，但也沒好多少：分別為 +0.26 與 +0.55。八條軌跡不等於八個獨立樣本，因此這些數字只能當作描述性的，不能作為推論。

blocks.en: The 15-23 columns count only the C-terminal nine residues, the one stretch present in all eight peptide-bearing systems. There are no whole-peptide averages here because the peptides run from 9 to 29 residues, and an average over them is not measuring the same thing twice. The apo row is mostly dashes for the same reason: with no peptide there is no clamp, no salt bridge and no contact count.
blocks.text: The 15-23 columns count only the C-terminal nine residues, the one stretch present in all eight peptide-bearing systems. There are no whole-peptide averages here because the peptides run from 9 to 29 residues, and an average over them is not measuring the same thing twice. The apo row is mostly dashes for the same reason: with no peptide there is no clamp, no salt bridge and no contact count.
blocks.zh: 15-23 的各欄只計入 C 端的九個殘基，那是八個含胜肽系統共同擁有的唯一一段。這裡沒有全胜肽的平均值，因為這些胜肽長度從 9 個到 29 個殘基不等，對它們取平均不會兩次量到同一件事。apo 那一列大多是破折號，原因相同：沒有胜肽，就沒有夾持、沒有鹽橋，也沒有接觸數。

blocks.en: Why 2.4% is not a weak salt bridge
blocks.text: Why 2.4% is not a weak salt bridge
blocks.zh: 為什麼 2.4% 不是一座弱鹽橋

blocks.en: The two-guanidinium-N column asks whether two nitrogens of the Arg487 guanidinium sit within 3.5 Å of a terminal oxygen of Asn23 at the same time. In the wild type that is a bidentate salt bridge, because Asn23 carries a free carboxylate with two terminal oxygens. The 6xHis construct has no OXT: Asn23 became an internal residue and its carboxylate was spent forming the amide bond to His24. On that construct the criterion is measuring one neutral amide carbonyl oxygen, so 2.4% is not a weak salt bridge. There is no salt bridge there to be weak.
blocks.text: The two-guanidinium-N column asks whether two nitrogens of the Arg487 guanidinium sit within 3.5 Å of a terminal oxygen of Asn23 at the same time. In the wild type that is a bidentate salt bridge, because Asn23 carries a free carboxylate with two terminal oxygens. The 6xHis construct has no OXT: Asn23 became an internal residue and its carboxylate was spent forming the amide bond to His24. On that construct the criterion is measuring one neutral amide carbonyl oxygen, so 2.4% is not a weak salt bridge. There is no salt bridge there to be weak.
blocks.zh: 「兩個胍基氮」這一欄問的是：Arg487 胍基的兩個氮是否同時位於 Asn23 某個末端氧的 3.5 Å 以內。在野生型中那就是一座雙齒鹽橋，因為 Asn23 帶有一個具兩個末端氧的自由羧酸根。6xHis 構築沒有 OXT：Asn23 變成了內部殘基，它的羧酸根已用於形成與 His24 之間的醯胺鍵。在那個構築上，這項標準量到的是單一個中性醯胺羰基氧，所以 2.4% 並不是一座弱鹽橋。那裡根本沒有鹽橋，談不上弱。

blocks.en: Ten receptor residues stay above 50% in all eight runs
blocks.text: Ten receptor residues stay above 50% in all eight runs
blocks.zh: 十個受體殘基在八條軌跡中都維持 50% 以上

blocks.en: Pool the per-residue contact occupancies across all eight peptide-bearing runs and ten receptor residues stay above 50% in every one of them, whatever the peptide is doing at the other end. Five of the ten are on the list of eight hotspots Tang and colleagues read off the AtPep1 complex; five are not. The five that are not are Ser275, Lys345, Tyr395, Phe419 and Ile463. Tang's list was assembled from one crystal structure of a different peptide, and this is what it looks like after eight trajectories of a second one.

Five of the ten are on the list of eight hotspots Tang and colleagues read off the AtPep1 complex; five are not. The five that are not are Ser275, Lys345, Tyr395, Phe419 and Ile463. Tang's list was assembled from one crystal structure of a different peptide, and this is what it looks like after eight trajectories of a second one.
blocks.zh: 把八次含胜肽模擬的每殘基接觸佔有率匯總起來，有十個受體殘基在每一次模擬中都維持 50% 以上，不論胜肽在另一端做什麼。這十個之中有五個落在 Tang 等人從 AtPep1 複合體讀出的八個熱點清單上，另外五個不在。不在清單上的那五個是 Ser275、Lys345、Tyr395、Phe419 與 Ile463。Tang 的清單是從另一條胜肽的單一晶體結構整理出來的，而這是在第二條胜肽的八條軌跡之後，它看起來的樣子。

blocks.en: Apo floor: receptor Cα 1.57 Å, groove 35.91 ± 0.55 Å
blocks.text: Apo floor: receptor Cα 1.57 Å, groove 35.91 ± 0.55 Å
blocks.zh: apo 底線：受體 Cα 1.57 Å，凹槽 35.91 ± 0.55 Å

blocks.en: The apo run exists to answer a question the other eight cannot: how much of the receptor motion they report would have happened anyway. Its receptor Cα RMSD is 1.57 Å, which is below all seven peptide-bearing runs it can be compared with. Those seven span 1.58 to 2.16 Å. Swapping one peptide for another therefore moves the receptor across a 0.59 Å range, and removing the peptide altogether moves it less than that. The binding groove holds at 35.91 ± 0.55 Å with nothing in it, and the per-residue flexibility profile correlates with the bound runs at r = 0.95. Any receptor-side difference smaller than about half an ångström on the other eight pages is inside this floor.
blocks.text: The apo run exists to answer a question the other eight cannot: how much of the receptor motion they report would have happened anyway. Its receptor Cα RMSD is 1.57 Å, which is below all seven peptide-bearing runs it can be compared with. Those seven span 1.58 to 2.16 Å. Swapping one peptide for another therefore moves the receptor across a 0.59 Å range, and removing the peptide altogether moves it less than that. The binding groove holds at 35.91 ± 0.55 Å with nothing in it, and the per-residue flexibility profile correlates with the bound runs at r = 0.95. Any receptor-side difference smaller than about half an ångström on the other eight pages is inside this floor.
blocks.zh: apo 模擬的存在，是為了回答另外八次模擬無法回答的問題：它們所報告的受體運動，有多少本來也會發生。它的受體 Cα RMSD 為 1.57 Å，低於所有七次可供比較的含胜肽模擬。那七次落在 1.58 到 2.16 Å 之間。因此，把一條胜肽換成另一條，會讓受體在 0.59 Å 的範圍內移動，而把胜肽整個移除，移動的幅度還更小。結合凹槽在空無一物時仍維持在 35.91 ± 0.55 Å，每殘基柔軟度分布與結合態各次模擬的相關係數為 r = 0.95。在另外八個頁面上，任何小於約 0.5 Å 的受體側差異，都落在這條底線之內。

blocks.en: pH 5.5 puts Glu12 on His227 at 2.75 Å in 99.9% of frames
blocks.text: pH 5.5 puts Glu12 on His227 at 2.75 Å in 99.9% of frames
blocks.zh: pH 5.5 讓 Glu12 以 2.75 Å 貼上 His227，佔 99.9% 影格

blocks.en: Switching His14 and His22 on the peptide and His227 on the receptor to their protonated form, with every other atom identical, locks the Glu12 carboxylate onto the His227 ring at 2.75 ± 0.11 Å in 99.9% of frames. At pH 7 the same pair sits 5.33 Å apart and appears in 0.8%. The AtPep1 benchmark already makes that contact at neutral pH, at 3.36 Å and 76.9%, so what pH 5.5 does for BoPEP4 is recover a contact its own calibrating control has natively. The C-terminal anchor is untouched and the 15-23 window becomes the tightest of any BoPEP4 run. Future BoPEP4 simulations should default to pH 5.5 with pH 7 as the control.
blocks.text: Switching His14 and His22 on the peptide and His227 on the receptor to their protonated form, with every other atom identical, locks the Glu12 carboxylate onto the His227 ring at 2.75 ± 0.11 Å in 99.9% of frames. At pH 7 the same pair sits 5.33 Å apart and appears in 0.8%. The AtPep1 benchmark already makes that contact at neutral pH, at 3.36 Å and 76.9%, so what pH 5.5 does for BoPEP4 is recover a contact its own calibrating control has natively. The C-terminal anchor is untouched and the 15-23 window becomes the tightest of any BoPEP4 run. Future BoPEP4 simulations should default to pH 5.5 with pH 7 as the control.
blocks.zh: 把胜肽上的 His14、His22 與受體上的 His227 切換為質子化形式，其餘每一個原子都保持相同，就讓 Glu12 的羧酸根以 2.75 ± 0.11 Å 鎖在 His227 的環上，佔 99.9% 的影格。在 pH 7 下，同一對相距 5.33 Å，只出現在 0.8% 的影格。AtPep1 基準在中性 pH 下就已形成那個接觸，距離 3.36 Å、佔 76.9%，所以 pH 5.5 為 BoPEP4 做的事，是找回一個它自己的校正對照本來就有的接觸。C 端錨點完全未受影響，15-23 區段也成為所有 BoPEP4 模擬中最緊的一個。日後的 BoPEP4 模擬應以 pH 5.5 為預設，並以 pH 7 作為對照。

blocks.en: The His14 pH-switch idea that motivated the run is not supported. Protonated or not, its ring nitrogens sit about 6.1 Å from the nearest receptor carboxylate, at 0.0% occupancy. The pH-sensing pair is receptor His227 with peptide Glu12.
blocks.text: The His14 pH-switch idea that motivated the run is not supported. Protonated or not, its ring nitrogens sit about 6.1 Å from the nearest receptor carboxylate, at 0.0% occupancy. The pH-sensing pair is receptor His227 with peptide Glu12.
blocks.zh: 促成這次模擬的 His14 pH 開關想法並未得到支持。無論是否質子化，它環上的氮都距離最近的受體羧酸根約 6.1 Å，佔有率為 0.0%。真正感測 pH 的一對，是受體的 His227 與胜肽的 Glu12。

blocks.en: ff19SB / OPC, 4 fs HMR, 30 ns on one A100
blocks.text: ff19SB / OPC, 4 fs HMR, 30 ns on one A100
blocks.zh: ff19SB / OPC，4 fs HMR，單張 A100 跑 30 奈秒

blocks.en: Every system was built on the PEPR1 ectodomain from PDB 5GR8, residues 29 to 738, and solvated in OPC water with AMBER ff19SB. Hydrogen mass repartitioning allows a 4 fs time step. Each system ran 30 ns of production after the same equilibration schedule, on one A100-SXM4-40GB at roughly 250 ns per day, for 25.9 GPU-hours and 13 500 saved frames in total. Systems are about 127 600 atoms. Every number on this page and on the nine reports comes from one analysis codebase run over all nine trajectories, so the columns mean the same thing across rows.
blocks.text: Every system was built on the PEPR1 ectodomain from PDB 5GR8, residues 29 to 738, and solvated in OPC water with AMBER ff19SB. Hydrogen mass repartitioning allows a 4 fs time step. Each system ran 30 ns of production after the same equilibration schedule, on one A100-SXM4-40GB at roughly 250 ns per day, for 25.9 GPU-hours and 13 500 saved frames in total. Systems are about 127 600 atoms. Every number on this page and on the nine reports comes from one analysis codebase run over all nine trajectories, so the columns mean the same thing across rows.
blocks.zh: 每個系統都建立在 PDB 5GR8 的 PEPR1 胞外結構域上，殘基 29 到 738，以 OPC 水溶劑化，並採用 AMBER ff19SB。氫原子質量重新分配讓時間步長可達 4 fs。每個系統在同一份平衡化流程之後跑 30 ns 的生產動力學，使用單張 A100-SXM4-40GB，速度約每日 250 ns，合計 25.9 GPU 小時、共存下 13 500 個影格。系統約有 127 600 個原子。本頁與九份報告上的每一個數字，都來自同一套分析程式碼對全部九條軌跡的運算，所以各欄在不同列之間的意義一致。

blocks.en: “pH 5.5” means three histidines held protonated for 30 ns
blocks.text: “pH 5.5” means three histidines held protonated for 30 ns
blocks.zh: 「pH 5.5」指的是三個組胺酸在 30 ns 內持續保持質子化

blocks.en: Molecular dynamics has no pH. The label names the protonation state the two protonated runs were given for the apoplast: His14 and His22 on the peptide and His227 on the receptor carry a positive charge, every other histidine is neutral, and all aspartates and glutamates are deprotonated. That assignment is fixed for the whole 30 ns and comes from model pKₓ values, not from PROPKA and not from constant-pH MD. Everything else in the set is at pH 7.
blocks.text: Molecular dynamics has no pH. The label names the protonation state the two protonated runs were given for the apoplast: His14 and His22 on the peptide and His227 on the receptor carry a positive charge, every other histidine is neutral, and all aspartates and glutamates are deprotonated. That assignment is fixed for the whole 30 ns and comes from model pKₓ values, not from PROPKA and not from constant-pH MD. Everything else in the set is at pH 7.
blocks.zh: 分子動力學裡沒有 pH。這個標籤指的是兩次質子化模擬為質外體所設定的質子化狀態：胜肽上的 His14 與 His22 以及受體上的 His227 帶正電，其餘組胺酸皆為中性，所有天門冬胺酸與麩胺酸都維持去質子化。這組設定在整段 30 ns 中固定不變，來自模型 pKₓ 值，而不是來自 PROPKA，也不是來自定 pH 分子動力學。本套其餘的模擬都在 pH 7。

blocks.en: 30 ns, one seed, nothing tested at the bench
blocks.text: 30 ns, one seed, nothing tested at the bench
blocks.zh: 30 奈秒、單一亂數種子、實驗桌上尚未驗證

blocks.en: Thirty nanoseconds is three to six orders of magnitude short of a dissociation event, so nothing here is a binding affinity, a leaving time or a free energy. The 15-23 run was designed to supply a leaving time and could not have, whatever it did. Each system has one seed, so a difference between two runs may be a difference between two relaxation paths. The acceptance gate was written before the tagged construct existed and, on that construct, measures atoms it does not have. And none of it has been checked at the bench: no binding assay, no thermal shift, no plant. Everything on this page is a hypothesis about what to build and what to measure next.

attrs.en: Nine all-atom trajectories of BoPEP4 on the PEPR1 ectodomain, 30 ns each. Nine separate reports is how they were produced; it is not how they should be read. This page is the map.
attrs.zh: BoPEP4 在 PEPR1 胞外結構域上的九條全原子軌跡，每條 30 ns。九份各自獨立的報告是它們被產出的方式，卻不是它們應該被閱讀的方式。本頁就是那張地圖。

attrs.en: On this page

attrs.en: All nine trajectories share one receptor, one force field, one equilibration schedule and one analysis codebase. Four things change between them: which peptide is bound, where it starts and stops, what sits on its C-terminus, and which histidines carry a charge. The map is the shape of those four choices. BoPEP4 sits at the centre; each limb is one thing we changed, and each chip on a limb is a trajectory that changed it.
attrs.zh: 九條軌跡共用同一個受體、同一套力場、同一份平衡化流程與同一套分析程式碼。它們之間有四件事不同：結合的是哪一條胜肽、它從哪裡開始到哪裡結束、它的 C 端上接著什麼，以及哪些組胺酸帶電。這張地圖就是那四個選擇的形狀。BoPEP4 位於中心；每一條分支是我們改動的一件事，分支上的每一個小塊則是改動了它的一條軌跡。

attrs.en: The map needs JavaScript. Without it, the nine reports are listed below, grouped the same way.
attrs.zh: 這張地圖需要 JavaScript。若未啟用，九份報告列在下方，分組方式相同。

attrs.en: Each report is a single self-contained file with its own 3D trajectory player and its own shareable link, so any one of them can be sent to a reader on its own. Whichever one you open, the navigation bar across the top will bring you back here.
attrs.zh: 每份報告都是單一個獨立完整的檔案，各自帶有 3D 軌跡播放器與可分享的連結，因此其中任何一份都能單獨寄給讀者。不論打開哪一份，頂端的導覽列都能帶你回到這裡。

attrs.en: Whether two runs can be compared directly is a question of how many columns apart they sit in this table. One column apart is a controlled comparison. Three columns apart is two experiments at once, and the set contains one of those on purpose: 9-23 at pH 5.5 crosses a truncation with a protonation change, and it is the run that failed.
attrs.zh: 兩次模擬能不能直接比較，取決於它們在這張表裡相隔幾欄。相隔一欄是一組控制良好的比較。相隔三欄就是同時做了兩個實驗，而本套中刻意包含一個這樣的例子：pH 5.5 的 9-23 把截短與質子化改動交叉在一起，而它正是未通過的那一次。

attrs.en: Eight of the nine runs carry a peptide, which makes this answerable with a number instead of an anecdote. Backbone RMSD over the shared 15-23 window, the kind of score constructs usually get ranked on, correlates with the bidentate Asn23-Arg487 salt bridge at Pearson +0.13 and Spearman +0.29. Against the four-contact clamp it is +0.03 the wrong way. Contact count does better and not by much: +0.26 and +0.55 respectively. Eight trajectories are not eight independent samples, so read these as descriptive, not inferential.
attrs.zh: 九次模擬中有八次帶胜肽，這讓問題可以用數字回答，而不是用個案。共有的 15-23 區段上的主鏈 RMSD，正是構築通常被拿來排名的那種分數，它與雙齒 Asn23-Arg487 鹽橋的相關係數為 Pearson +0.13、Spearman +0.29。對四接觸夾持則是 +0.03，方向還是反的。接觸數好一些，但也沒好多少：分別為 +0.26 與 +0.55。八條軌跡不等於八個獨立樣本，因此這些數字只能當作描述性的，不能作為推論。

attrs.en: The practical consequence is on this page twice. Ranked on RMSD the 6xHis construct comes first in the set, and it is the one construct whose salt bridge is gone. Ranked on RMSD the failed run comes second.
attrs.zh: 這件事的實際後果在本頁出現了兩次。按 RMSD 排名，6xHis 構築在整套中排第一，而它正是唯一鹽橋已經消失的構築。同樣按 RMSD 排名，未通過的那次模擬排第二。

attrs.en: The 15-23 columns count only the C-terminal nine residues, the one stretch present in all eight peptide-bearing systems. There are no whole-peptide averages here because the peptides run from 9 to 29 residues, and an average over them is not measuring the same thing twice. The apo row is mostly dashes for the same reason: with no peptide there is no clamp, no salt bridge and no contact count.
attrs.zh: 15-23 的各欄只計入 C 端的九個殘基，那是八個含胜肽系統共同擁有的唯一一段。這裡沒有全胜肽的平均值，因為這些胜肽長度從 9 個到 29 個殘基不等，對它們取平均不會兩次量到同一件事。apo 那一列大多是破折號，原因相同：沒有胜肽，就沒有夾持、沒有鹽橋，也沒有接觸數。

attrs.en: Why 2.4% is not a weak salt bridge
attrs.zh: 為什麼 2.4% 不是一座弱鹽橋

attrs.en: The two-guanidinium-N column asks whether two nitrogens of the Arg487 guanidinium sit within 3.5 Å of a terminal oxygen of Asn23 at the same time. In the wild type that is a bidentate salt bridge, because Asn23 carries a free carboxylate with two terminal oxygens. The 6xHis construct has no OXT: Asn23 became an internal residue and its carboxylate was spent forming the amide bond to His24. On that construct the criterion is measuring one neutral amide carbonyl oxygen, so 2.4% is not a weak salt bridge. There is no salt bridge there to be weak.
attrs.zh: 「兩個胍基氮」這一欄問的是：Arg487 胍基的兩個氮是否同時位於 Asn23 某個末端氧的 3.5 Å 以內。在野生型中那就是一座雙齒鹽橋，因為 Asn23 帶有一個具兩個末端氧的自由羧酸根。6xHis 構築沒有 OXT：Asn23 變成了內部殘基，它的羧酸根已用於形成與 His24 之間的醯胺鍵。在那個構築上，這項標準量到的是單一個中性醯胺羰基氧，所以 2.4% 並不是一座弱鹽橋。那裡根本沒有鹽橋，談不上弱。

attrs.en: Pool the per-residue contact occupancies across all eight peptide-bearing runs and ten receptor residues stay above 50% in every one of them, whatever the peptide is doing at the other end. Five of the ten are on the list of eight hotspots Tang and colleagues read off the AtPep1 complex; five are not. The five that are not are Ser275, Lys345, Tyr395, Phe419 and Ile463. Tang's list was assembled from one crystal structure of a different peptide, and this is what it looks like after eight trajectories of a second one.
attrs.zh: 把八次含胜肽模擬的每殘基接觸佔有率匯總起來，有十個受體殘基在每一次模擬中都維持 50% 以上，不論胜肽在另一端做什麼。這十個之中有五個落在 Tang 等人從 AtPep1 複合體讀出的八個熱點清單上，另外五個不在。不在清單上的那五個是 Ser275、Lys345、Tyr395、Phe419 與 Ile463。Tang 的清單是從另一條胜肽的單一晶體結構整理出來的，而這是在第二條胜肽的八條軌跡之後，它看起來的樣子。

attrs.en: The apo run exists to answer a question the other eight cannot: how much of the receptor motion they report would have happened anyway. Its receptor Cα RMSD is 1.57 Å, which is below all seven peptide-bearing runs it can be compared with. Those seven span 1.58 to 2.16 Å. Swapping one peptide for another therefore moves the receptor across a 0.59 Å range, and removing the peptide altogether moves it less than that. The binding groove holds at 35.91 ± 0.55 Å with nothing in it, and the per-residue flexibility profile correlates with the bound runs at r = 0.95. Any receptor-side difference smaller than about half an ångström on the other eight pages is inside this floor.
attrs.zh: apo 模擬的存在，是為了回答另外八次模擬無法回答的問題：它們所報告的受體運動，有多少本來也會發生。它的受體 Cα RMSD 為 1.57 Å，低於所有七次可供比較的含胜肽模擬。那七次落在 1.58 到 2.16 Å 之間。因此，把一條胜肽換成另一條，會讓受體在 0.59 Å 的範圍內移動，而把胜肽整個移除，移動的幅度還更小。結合凹槽在空無一物時仍維持在 35.91 ± 0.55 Å，每殘基柔軟度分布與結合態各次模擬的相關係數為 r = 0.95。在另外八個頁面上，任何小於約 0.5 Å 的受體側差異，都落在這條底線之內。

attrs.en: Switching His14 and His22 on the peptide and His227 on the receptor to their protonated form, with every other atom identical, locks the Glu12 carboxylate onto the His227 ring at 2.75 ± 0.11 Å in 99.9% of frames. At pH 7 the same pair sits 5.33 Å apart and appears in 0.8%. The AtPep1 benchmark already makes that contact at neutral pH, at 3.36 Å and 76.9%, so what pH 5.5 does for BoPEP4 is recover a contact its own calibrating control has natively. The C-terminal anchor is untouched and the 15-23 window becomes the tightest of any BoPEP4 run. Future BoPEP4 simulations should default to pH 5.5 with pH 7 as the control.
attrs.zh: 把胜肽上的 His14、His22 與受體上的 His227 切換為質子化形式，其餘每一個原子都保持相同，就讓 Glu12 的羧酸根以 2.75 ± 0.11 Å 鎖在 His227 的環上，佔 99.9% 的影格。在 pH 7 下，同一對相距 5.33 Å，只出現在 0.8% 的影格。AtPep1 基準在中性 pH 下就已形成那個接觸，距離 3.36 Å、佔 76.9%，所以 pH 5.5 為 BoPEP4 做的事，是找回一個它自己的校正對照本來就有的接觸。C 端錨點完全未受影響，15-23 區段也成為所有 BoPEP4 模擬中最緊的一個。日後的 BoPEP4 模擬應以 pH 5.5 為預設，並以 pH 7 作為對照。

attrs.en: The His14 pH-switch idea that motivated the run is not supported. Protonated or not, its ring nitrogens sit about 6.1 Å from the nearest receptor carboxylate, at 0.0% occupancy. The pH-sensing pair is receptor His227 with peptide Glu12.
attrs.zh: 促成這次模擬的 His14 pH 開關想法並未得到支持。無論是否質子化，它環上的氮都距離最近的受體羧酸根約 6.1 Å，佔有率為 0.0%。真正感測 pH 的一對，是受體的 His227 與胜肽的 Glu12。

attrs.en: Every system was built on the PEPR1 ectodomain from PDB 5GR8, residues 29 to 738, and solvated in OPC water with AMBER ff19SB. Hydrogen mass repartitioning allows a 4 fs time step. Each system ran 30 ns of production after the same equilibration schedule, on one A100-SXM4-40GB at roughly 250 ns per day, for 25.9 GPU-hours and 13,500 saved frames in total. Systems are about 127,600 atoms. Every number on this page and on the nine reports comes from one analysis codebase run over all nine trajectories, so the columns mean the same thing across rows.
attrs.zh: 每個系統都建立在 PDB 5GR8 的 PEPR1 胞外結構域上，殘基 29 到 738，以 OPC 水溶劑化，並採用 AMBER ff19SB。氫原子質量重新分配讓時間步長可達 4 fs。每個系統在同一份平衡化流程之後跑 30 ns 的生產動力學，使用單張 A100-SXM4-40GB，速度約每日 250 ns，合計 25.9 GPU 小時、共存下 13,500 個影格。系統約有 127,600 個原子。本頁與九份報告上的每一個數字，都來自同一套分析程式碼對全部九條軌跡的運算，所以各欄在不同列之間的意義一致。

attrs.en: “pH 5.5” means three histidines held protonated for 30 ns
attrs.zh: 「pH 5.5」指的是三個組胺酸在 30 ns 內持續保持質子化

attrs.en: Molecular dynamics has no pH.
